name: Newport Children's Theatre Summer Theatre Camps
description_short: Newport Children's Theatre runs summer theatre camps for ages 8-18 at its studio in Middletown, RI: a one-week Performance Potpourri camp for ages 8-12 (acting, improv, writing scenes) and two-week camps that put on a musical and a play with public performances. 2026 shows were Newsies Jr. and The Three Musketeers.

sessions.name: Summer Musical: Newsies Jr. (ages 8-18; auditions July 11; performances July 25)
Summer Theatre Camp: The Three Musketeers (ages 8-18; performance Aug 8)

sources.note: Summer Camps page: ages 8-12 June 29-July 2nd; ages 8-18 July 13-25th; ages 8-18 July 27-August 8th; 'NCT Studio: 1341 West Main St. • Middletown, RI'.

'Performance Potpourri Camp: June 29-July 2 • 9:30-2:30pm'; acting and improv, write monologues/scenes/sketches; 'Typically, we require you bring lunch'. Description also uses the Newsies and Three Musketeers pages.

Session details from the three camp pages: Potpourri $275 through 4/15/26 ($300 after); Newsies 'Camp: July 13th-24th at St. Mary's Church • Portsmouth', performances July 25, $650 through 4/15 ($700 after); Three Musketeers ('Summer Theatre Camp 2026') July 27-Aug 7, performance Aug 8, $550 through 4/15 ($575 after). Session prices are the early-bird prices.
'Families needing support may contact us ... financial aid opportunities'; refund policy with $50 fee and 30/14-day tiers.

refund_policy_summary: Full payment (or a third-party payment plan) at registration; early-bird prices through April 15. Refunds carry a $50 fee: full refund more than 30 days before start, 50% at 14-30 days, none under 14 days. No refund for missed days or dismissal.
